verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm with a client portal and company program management, so a public API spec is a plausible thing for a buyer to ask about, and the axis applies. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and no documentation mentions an API or a machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file is an adjacent AI-readability feature, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
